source: Maintainer-provided resize_and_preview.py from the prior manual update workflow
runtime_changes: FFmpeg is configurable or discovered from PATH; no hardcoded machine path.
Thumbnail renaming runs even when already 384x384.
Preview generation can replace an existing preview explicitly.
Difficulty metadata is matched by ratingClass rather than list index.
Temporary files are cleaned and conversion errors propagate.
Full audio is preserved until the caller explicitly removes a work copy.
